openings.claim: The sampling log alone may make limited review reproducible by changing retrospective inspection reasons into pre-access commitments of each record identifier, priority criterion and intended decision relevance. Use the supplied spreadsheet or script; prioritize flagged rows in the slice losing two and the improvement slice with annotator disagreements, with fixed identifier order within priorities. This does not establish deployment readiness.
openings.discriminator: Against an ordinary retrospective sampling log with the same priority rule, commitments should expose selection-rule deviations and distinguish planned selection from post-result justification. Accuracy may be unchanged or worse; priorities cannot resolve remaining labels. Defeat includes equally reconstructable rival reasons, no exposed deviations, poorer supported decisions, or insufficient replay time.
openings.probe: Use only supplied records and labels: two matched copies with independently reset allowances, one per variant, and the same four preselected withheld rows. Allow twenty-five minutes per variant and twenty for replay/key comparison, totaling seventy; at most sixteen returned adjudications per copy. Record selection commitments, returned labels, unavailable attempts, elapsed time and allowance consumed; withheld attempts consume no allowance. Freeze advance/reject/unresolved reports, affected slices and complete access ledgers before opening the sealed full-label key. Compare reconstructable reasons, deviations, allowance accounting and decision agreement with the key. Preserve advance thresholds: total correct improves at least four and no slice loses more than two. Report unresolved whenever remaining label possibilities can change acceptance.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes supplied records support deterministic identifier ordering and locating relevant flagged rows. Missing/withheld labels may force unresolved. Replay is descriptive; two runs cannot establish reliable general performance. Supplied evidence does not establish the effect.

lineage.reason: Preserves the pre-access causal transfer, rival, defeat conditions, constraints, resource caveats, assumptions and declared preserves fit.

decision: Retain D1 as an auditable-selection hypothesis. No evaluation was performed; retain uncertainty about effects and supported decisions. Advance, reject or unresolved requires executing the supplied rule within the adjudication and time limits.
